title: Chapter 356 - 356 The Son Of The Boss' Good Friend; Liar!
content:
Chapter 356 - 356 The Son Of The Boss' Good Friend; Liar!

Chapter 356 - 356 The Son of the Boss' Good Friend; Liar!

356 The Son of the Boss’ Good Friend; Liar!

Rumble!

After a series of decelerations and bumps, the plane finally stopped.

The moment Li Li got off the plane, she took a deep breath and praised, “As expected of Eagle Country. The air is so fresh and sweet!”

Then, she looked into the distance and took out her phone to post a message on social media.

[How big of an influence does the environment have on a person? I’m in Lun City, and I’ve just gotten off the plane.

[The buildings in Lun City have a strong European and American style and a sense of history. Even people from Hua Nation won’t be able to help but set higher standards for themselves, improve their quality, and transform themselves into polite gentlemen and elegant ladies upon coming here…

[My foreign friend’s father is friends with the owner of Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel. He has already arranged for the people from the Royal Hotel to come and pick us up.]

Li Li’s fingers were flying. In just a minute, she had written a post with more than a hundred words.

After putting down her phone, her eyes quickly noticed a prominent banner not far away—Welcome to Lun City, Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel.

Around the banner stood many men in suits and women with graceful figures.

Several Rolls-Royce cars were parked behind, and there was even a helicopter!

Seeing this…

“Jonah, are these the people who came to pick us up?” Li Li said excitedly.

In fact, Jonah Roger had also noticed the banner and the group of people.

He was a little puzzled earlier, wondering if this was the group who came to pick him up.

This formation seemed a little too big.

However, when he saw how excited Li Li was, Jonah Roger puffed out his chest and said, “Of course, they’re here to pick us up! My dad is a good friend of the owner of the Royal Hotel!”

What he was thinking was that he had spent so much money to stay at Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel. It was normal for them to welcome him with huge fanfare.

When Li Li heard this, her face was full of smiles. She followed Jonah Roger to where the banner was.

“Are you from the Royal Hotel?” Jonah asked.

Jack Smith, the chairman of Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel, frowned slightly.

General Manager Edward Mullen said, “Yes, we’re from the Royal Hotel. Sir, what can I do for you?”

Jonah looked up and said, “That’s good. I’ve already booked a room. Oh right, my dad is also good friends with the owner of Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel.”

He said this without any pressure.

It was because Jonah Roger did not believe that such a small matter would be reported to the owner.

Originally, Chairman Jack Smith did not want to bother with Jonah Roger at all.

However, after hearing this, his heart skipped a beat. He said respectfully, “Hello, I’m Jack Smith. May I know your name?”

Jonah Roger saw that as he had expected, the other party could not tell whether what he said was the truth or not.

Moreover, he was so respectful to him.

He secretly glanced at Li Li, who was admiring him more and more. He said proudly, “I’m Jonah Roger.”

Just as Chairman Jack Smith was about to say something, his expression suddenly turned cold and he said seriously, “Everyone, line up and prepare for the welcoming ceremony!”

As he spoke, he hurriedly went forward.

It was because he had seen his boss… Lin Fan!

Lin Fan, Chu Yunyue, and the staff of Flower Stem slowly got off the luxury plane under the respectful escort of the beautiful air stewardesses.

“Welcome to Lun City, Eagle Country, Mr. Lin!” Chairman Jack Smith greeted respectfully.

Immediately after, a group of men in suits and women with graceful figures behind him shouted in unison, “Welcome to Lun City, Eagle Country, Mr. Lin!”

Chu Yunyue and the other employees of the Flower Stem were a little stunned.

All of them turned to look at Lin Fan.

Lin Fan did not feel too uncomfortable and said, “You must be Jack Smith?”

Chairman Jack Smith, who was standing at the front, said, “Yes, Mr. Lin. We have already prepared a means of transportation for you. Would you like to go to the Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel to rest for a while?”

“Alright.” Lin Fan nodded.

“Mr. Lin, this way please,” Jack Smith said respectfully.

Lin Fan, Chu Yunyue, and the staff of Flower Stem, surrounded by a large group of foreigners, came to the helicopter.

At this moment, Jack Smith seemed to have thought of something and said, “By the way, Mr. Lin, your good friend’s son seems to be here. Do you want to bring him along?”

Lin Fan was puzzled. “My good friend’s son?”

He did not have many good friends.

Even if one of them had given birth to a son, he had probably just learned how to walk, right?

Yet he came to Eagle Country just like that?

Jack Smith pointed at the fair-skinned Jonah Roger and said, “Yes, he just arrived.”

Lin Fan sized up Jonah Roger and said, “I don’t know him.”

With that, he turned around and walked into the helicopter.

Jack Smith was a smart man. At this moment, how could he not understand that this man was simply lying?!

After glaring at Jonah Roger, he also boarded the helicopter.

Rumble!

The helicopter let out a roar as its propellers spun rapidly, forming a small hurricane as it soared into the sky.

The Rolls-Royce motorcade parked next to the helicopter was speeding in the same direction.

The helicopter in the sky and the Rolls-Royce fleet on the ground were all there to welcome Lin Fan. It was a luxurious sight.

The luxury plane was too fast and was above the clouds. There was no way to enjoy the scenery of Lun City.

The speed of the helicopter was relatively slow and flew at a low altitude. It was just enough for Lin Fan and the others to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Lun City.

They looked at the European-style buildings with curiosity on their faces.

“That seems to be the Shield Eye!”

“Is this it? It looks similar to the Ferris wheel in our country.”

“That’s the Tower Bridge of Lun City!”

“That… seems okay.”

“Is that the security tower?”

“It seems rather ordinary.”

Everyone commented from time to time.

Although the buildings were a little novel, they were not shocking.

…

As Lin Fan and the others boarded the helicopter and looked down at Lun City, Li Li and Jonah Roger, who were standing on the ground, were blown by the strong winds from the helicopter. Their clothes and hair rustled, and the dust made them cough.

The two of them only recovered after the helicopter took off.

“Jonah Roger, didn’t you say that they were here to pick us up?” Li Li said.

“This…” Jonah Roger said awkwardly.

“Didn’t you say that your father and the owner of the Royal Hotel were good friends?” Li Li shouted.

“This…” Jonah Roger did not know how to answer.

“You liar!” Li Li shouted.

After saying that, she turned around and left.
